title: Jailbreak transfer as a homogeneity meter: mapping shared vulnerability across an open-model family tree

original_idea.body:
# Jailbreak transfer as a homogeneity meter

Jailbreak transferability is argued to emerge from shared representations (arXiv 2506.12913). Use pairwise jailbreak transfer success across open models with known lineage to build a vulnerability dendrogram; test whether transfer rate tracks lineage. Public jailbreak prompts and open models only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (transfer as homogeneity meter informs concentration-risk audits) with a gap from metric to averted catastrophe.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: clear inherited methodology; novice with mentor can execute on open models.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (pairwise transfer matrix + dendrogram) with manageable dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: uses public jailbreaks and open models, weak lab incentive, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on several open models, single consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Transfer-as-similarity-metric framing across lineage may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Jailbreak transfer studied but using it as a lineage homogeneity metric is a plausibly open angle.
